data.title: Ling Wu Dalu
data.synopsis:
Lingwu Continent is a world where spiritual power and martial spirit coexist. A spiritual cultivator can move mountains and rivers with a thought, and a martial artist can tear the world apart with bare hands. Chen Tian, ​​a former genius in Xingchen Town, lost his martial spirit and dried up his spiritual sea after he turned ten.

Since then, he has become a waste of his family and has been looked down upon by others. In a life-and-death struggle, Chen Tian fell off a cliff and mistakenly entered the formation arranged by the ancient sword emperor. Under the influence of the power of the heavenly book, he awakened his spiritual and martial dual cultivation physique. At the same time, he also obtained a strange memory and a mysterious storage ring. 

From then on, he rose from adversity, broke through the reincarnation of the Heavenly Dao Palm, and finally crossed the shackles of the emperor's calamity and aspired to become the champion of Lingwu Continent!

(Source: iQIYI)

data.title: Tian Ying
data.synopsis:
Lu Chen, the "Shadow" undercover agent of Fuyun Division, was cursed by black fire for destroying the demon sect's divine spell, and his cultivation was completely destroyed. After ten years of living in exile and seclusion, Master Tian Lan appeared again and gave Lu Chen the task of going to the Kunlun Sect to find the undercover demon sect. In order to repair the damaged Five Elements God Disk, Lu Chen was ordered to become a hundred of the Kunlun Sect. A handyman disciple in the thatched cottage. In the process of carrying out the mission, he met many friends and the love of his life Yi Xin, and gradually felt the warmth of the world. At the same time, he touched on the secrets behind Kunlun from various clues, and discovered that the black dragon sealed in the Kunlun Forbidden Land was not an evil monster, but had always claimed to be for The righteous Tian Lan actually had other plans. After realizing the facts, Lu Chen was confused for a while. With Yi Xin's encouragement, he decided to face the past and no longer stick to the so-called distinction between good and evil, but to follow his heart and do the right thing.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

data.title: Wujin Shenyu
data.synopsis:
Seven years ago, the family of the mortal prince Li Han was killed by seven immortals. When he was dying, he and his sister Li Yao were saved by the legendary Endless God Realm. Seven years later, Li Han returned. In order to wake up his sister, he must constantly improve his cultivation according to the requirements of the God Realm to protect the people. At the same time, he also vowed to find the murderer of that year and take revenge! But things are more complicated than he imagined. As the truth is revealed bit by bit, Li Han must make a choice between revenge and gratitude...

(Source: iQIYI, Google translated)

data.title: Donut Hole
data.synopsis:
GUMI, Hatsune Miku, Megurine Luka, and Kagamine Rin run a junk collection business in a messy downtown area. They drive around in a light truck and collect broken TVs, computers, and other items while playing silly announcements over the speaker.

Their office is in a corner of a multi-tenant building and calls itself a recycle shop, but most of it looks like a warehouse with junk lined up with price tags. Before long, the four of them start receiving requests for junk that they can't handle on their own and by chance the abandoned items end up in GUMI's hands.

Meanwhile, in the city center, an environmental beautification organization is formed and a cleanup operation for the downtown area is about to begin, under the pretext of redeveloping the area into a beautiful town. GUMI and the others rebel against the way of life in the downtown area that is gradually being threatened. As the government and beautification organizations each have their own agenda, breaking news breaks that a dangerous creature has been found on the garbage dump and a drastic move is made to clean up the dump, along with the downtown area, turning it into a vacant lot.

(Source: Kenshi Yonezu YouTube Channel; translated)
